findings.claim: source.doc docs/SYNAPSE-memory-engineering-spec.md is ABSENT from this worktree; executed against the brief-embedded targets/acceptance (self-contained). Corroborated by W3-STORE.
The 2026-08-09 store census is STALE: R2 memory.jsonl grew 4 -> 583 lines by 2026-08-13. verify/backup recount from LIVE disk; the census is used only for the store PATH list, never its counts.

Raw jsonl line count != memory count. memory.jsonl is an append-log; the decrypting MemoryStore loader collapses lines to the distinct current memory set (R10 39 lines -> 21 memories; R8 19 -> 7). Count parity is measured on MEMORIES (the loader/system definition), with source_jsonl_lines reported alongside for transparency.

'typed USD prims' is aspirational. Moneta persists as .moneta/snapshot.json (JSON ECS rows) — the store's own 'durable source of truth'. USD sublayer authoring (.moneta/usd/) is DEAD BYTES until the MonetaMemory schema is registered (PXR_PLUGINPATH_NAME unset; separate leg fix/moneta-schema-registration / W3-STORE cortex). Migration is verified on the durable snapshot rows. A literal typed-USD-prim count is therefore UNKNOWN today, not falsely reported as passing.

DIM HAZARD: Moneta default embedder is 384-dim; reopening a 256-dim on-disk snapshot at 384 hard-crashes in hydrate (vector_index dim guard). The exporter detects the on-disk dim (snapshot_dim) and pins a matching embedder BEFORE opening a target with rows (test_export_pins_existing_dim_no_crash). The LIVE seat is currently degraded per W3-DIM (backend moneta falls back to jsonl: expected 384 got 256) — a durable go-live REQUIRES wave3/dim's reconcile merged first.
